description:
Get ready for a fun and exciting adventure with the most amazing little pigs in town!

Every year, the little town holds the Big Young Pig Race, and this year promises to be the most exciting one yet. Join Runi, the fastest little pig, Mia, the most cunning strategist, and Len, the brave and strong one of the group, as they compete in a race full of natural obstacles, unexpected surprises, and unforgettable lessons.

But they won't be alone: along the way, they'll meet Tito, a lonely and competitive pig whose defiant attitude will test the true strength of teamwork.

A journey full of values:

·Discover the importance of cooperation.

·Learn how to overcome fears with courage and perseverance.

·Celebrate the power of friendship, because together, we are stronger!

·With adorable characters, funny situations, and a message that will touch the hearts of the whole family, this story is a celebration of true team spirit.

·Perfect for playing or enjoying with the family: This story combines action, humour, and positive values that both children and adults will love.

Who will win the race? The answer is on the road!
name: The Brave Little Pigs
intro: This visual novel follows a group of young pigs who participate in their town's annual race for the first time.
